source_gate_binding.event_set_rule: Use only events already route-qualified in the bound source receipt; no additions, substitutions, exclusions, venue switches, or post-market filtering after this freeze.

scientific_question: Do official Binance full-token delisting announcements predict negative token performance between a causal post-publication entry boundary and the final tradable spot boundary, beyond contemporaneous BTC market movement?

timing.publication_time: Official Binance publication timestamp from the bound source receipt.
timing.entry_price: OPEN of the 1h SYMBOLUSDT bar whose open timestamp equals entry_timestamp.
timing.terminal_timestamp: SCHEDULED_ALL_PAIRS_CESSATION_TIMESTAMP from the bound source receipt.
timing.terminal_price: CLOSE of the last complete 1h SYMBOLUSDT bar ending at or before terminal_timestamp. If no exact causal bar exists, fail that event closed as DATA_FAILURE_EVENT; do not substitute another venue or interpolate.
timing.benchmark_entry_price: BTCUSDT 1h OPEN at the same entry_timestamp.
timing.benchmark_terminal_price: BTCUSDT 1h CLOSE at the same terminal boundary rule.
timing.overlap_policy: Each token-event is evaluated once. Multiple tokens in one Binance announcement remain separate token outcomes but share one announcement cluster for inference.

cost_model.reason: Binance Spot price history establishes the predictive event effect but does not by itself establish a historically executable short vehicle. A margin/perpetual execution study with borrow/funding/slippage/fees requires a separate prospective MVE if this predictive Discovery survives.

statistical_inference.directional_test: For negative expected direction, the two-sided 95% confidence interval upper bound of the mean BTC-adjusted log return must be strictly below zero.
statistical_inference.jackknife: Leave-one-announcement-cluster-out mean BTC-adjusted log return must remain below zero for every cluster.

promotion_gates.execution_note: A predictive pass is not a tradable diamond. It only authorizes consideration of a separate prospective executable-short MVE; it does not authorize 2025/2026 or live trading.

next_authorized_action: Build and audit an outcome-blind Discovery runner against this exact freeze. Do not execute market outcomes until separate explicit authorization is given.
